title: A double-click on a pane's name also starts a pane drag
body:
A double-click on a pane's name on its Ctrl bar opens the rename field (9c9668c). The first press on the name also starts a pane drag, since dragging a pane by its name already exists. The drag does nothing on release, but the drag ghost may flash under the pointer between the two clicks.

## Proposal

A press on the pane's name starts the drag only once the pointer moves a few pixels, so a click or double-click never starts one.
